column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiLoginCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column3: The default every earlier version shipped for gui-mode.title-login. It is the setting's Java default, which the framework writes for a missing key, and is compared byte for byte by materializeText to recognise an operator file nobody edited, which is then rewritten to the colour code plus the language file's text in the server's language (maintainer decision 2026-09-25, UltiKits/UltiLogin#20). Under language: zh that text is these same bytes, so no text reaches a player from this literal that the language file does not also hold. The text players see comes from the language file
